items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: individual achievement badge for a native macOS Caffeine app. Create ONE polished square PNG with a genuinely transparent background. This is the FIRST SIP award, 5 minutes. Subject: a single petite ivory espresso cup and saucer with one delicate curl of steam, centered inside a circular copper medallion with a warm ivory enamel face and thin espresso-brown rim, one subtle tiny sparkle. Friendly premium collectible enamel-pin illustration, crisp softly rounded vector-like forms, slight tasteful dimensional bevel, restrained warm coffee palette, clear silhouette readable at 64px. Front-facing symmetric badge, generous transparent padding, badge occupies about 78% of canvas. The cup has no face. No letters, numbers, captions, typography, watermark, background rectangle, or cast shadow outside the medallion. The award title and time will be supplied as native UI labels, not baked into the image. This is the simplest entry-level badge; later badges will grow more ornate.

Crisp iconic artwork legible at 64px. Square PNG with truly transparent background, generous transparent padding, medallion about 78% of canvas. Center the entire complete badge. Match the same family and medallion scale but distinguish the new subject strongly. No letters, numbers, captions, typography, watermark, background rectangle, or shadow outside the badge. Labels are provided separately in native UI. Subject: an elegant ivory espresso cup seen slightly from above with beautiful heart-shaped latte art, two small coffee beans framing it, expressive sculpted steam. This award is Espresso Yourself at 1 hour.
